notes: Federal marriage equality since Obergefell v. Hodges (2015). Federal employment non-discrimination via Bostock v. Clayton County (2020). Sub-national protections vary by state.
Civil Marriage Act (2005) provides nationwide marriage equality. Canadian Human Rights Act prohibits discrimination based on sexual orientation and gender identity.
Supreme Court ruling (2015) established marriage equality federally; all 31 states have implemented it. Federal anti-discrimination law covers sexual orientation.
Marriage (Same Sex Couples) Act 2013 (England & Wales), Marriage and Civil Partnership (Scotland) Act 2014. Equality Act 2010 provides broad protections.
Marriage equality since October 2017 (Gesetz zur Einführung des Rechts auf Eheschließung für Personen gleichen Geschlechts). General Equal Treatment Act (AGG) covers sexual orientation.
Marriage equality since 2005 (Ley 13/2005). Spain was the third country in the world to legalise same-sex marriage. Comprehensive anti-discrimination framework.
Marriage equality since 2010. Joint adoption rights since 2016. Constitution prohibits discrimination on grounds of sexual orientation.
First country in the world to legalise same-sex marriage (2001). Equal Treatment Act prohibits discrimination on grounds of sexual orientation.

No national same-sex marriage or partnership recognition as of 2024, though some municipalities offer partnership certificates. No comprehensive national anti-discrimination law for sexual orientation.

Marriage Equality Act signed September 2024 (effective January 2025), making Thailand the first Southeast Asian country to legalise same-sex marriage. No comprehensive anti-discrimination legislation for sexual orientation.
